test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

**She said me** the truth.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**said**" is not used directly with an object (e.g., "me").
 
• The correct verb to use in this context is "**told**," which is always followed by an object.
 
• Option 2, "**said to me**," is grammatically correct but less commonly used in this context compared to "**told me**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She told me the truth."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "**said to me**" is grammatically correct but less commonly used in this context. It would be more appropriate in a different sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3:** "**says me**" is incorrect because the verb "says" cannot be used with an object like "me."
 
• **Option 4:** "**spoke to me**" is incorrect because the verb "spoke" does not fit the meaning of "telling the truth" in this context.
